recaps.ending: Arthur removes the former Blood Moon leader's cards after the leader attacks him, while Brixaby takes Call of Life from the leader's dragon and openly reveals his legendary nature. Arthur assumes control of Blood Moon Hive and leaves Horatio and Sams in temporary command as another eruption approaches. Arthur then travels to the palace with Brixaby, Cressida, Marion, Desmond, and Sybil. Lung Bai accepts Arthur's new authority, warns that Call of Life can kill as readily as heal, and identifies Asha as an origin of healing. Marion and Asha briefly restore the king's awareness, but they cannot cure his underlying brain condition. A stable king might help regulate the eruptions, leaving his fragile recovery, Blood Moon's transition, Larry's unfinished investigation, Arthur's concealed time card, Brixaby's dangerous new power, and the wider eruption crisis unresolved.
recaps.in_short: Arthur and his retinue infiltrate Blood Moon Hive while seeking another card for Brixaby and discover a regime that extracts shards or life force through the blood price. As captain of neglected Purple Wing, Arthur pairs riders and dragons, improves food and pay, and builds a rescue-first force. A secret expedition into an old eruption cone reveals underground nests and a core that feeds them. Destroying it gives Arthur origin shards, which he and Brixaby forge into a concealed legendary time card. During the next eruption, a legendary demi-Scourgeling appears, and Blood Moon's leader destroys it with dangerous life energy before turning on Arthur. Arthur strips the leader's cards, Brixaby claims Call of Life, and they take control of the hive. At the palace, Marion and Asha temporarily restore the ailing king's awareness, but an imminent eruption and the kingdom's deeper instability remain unresolved.

recaps.text: Previously: Arthur and Brixaby emerged as a legendary-linked pair amid conflicts involving the hives, the Rowantree succession, and Scourge threats. The mind-controlling Mindsinger escaped with followers, eggs, a corrupted dragon body, and a legendary card. Arthur's cousin Pennrow remains a rival legendary holder and competing Rowantree claimant, while Arthur's father Calvan is vulnerable at the border and his uncle Lionel remains a threat. Wolf Moon Hive is politically divided, and Mesa Free Hive is still developing its defenses. Arthur also carries unresolved danger from Baron Kane's interest in his legendary card and from Second, a hostile associate who claims an obligation from an earlier rescue. Lung Bai supplied mythic help on the condition that Arthur eventually return to Wolf Moon Hive. Arthur leads a retinue that includes Cressida and Joy, Horatio and Sams, Marion and Asha, and Soledad and Equinox.

Arthur risks destroying Cressida's four animal-summon cards in an attempt to combine them. He succeeds, creating the Animal Summoning Set, gaining Set Creation, and opening a hidden Cardomancy class, though the effort leaves him severely drained. Horatio and Sams then demonstrate a costly technique that converts gathered light into magical darkness while preserving allies' vision. The retinue decides to return toward its own kingdom, but Arthur first plans to visit Blood Moon Hive, where Brixaby senses another card from his set. Rumors connect the secretive hive with attacks on vulnerable card wielders. Arthur, Cressida, Brixaby, and Joy travel to the central cities and secure cards that can disguise rank and appearance. There they see Blood Moon riders intimidating merchants and encounter farmers driven to robbery after an eruption destroyed their land. Their leader, Ciaran, reports that riders from another hive took survivors' supplies. Arthur offers seeds for a potentially valuable crop. He now has the tools for an infiltration and evidence that hive power is being used against civilians.

Arthur's group plans to enter Blood Moon Hive during an eruption, using false ranks to resemble a rare dragon's uncommon followers. Arthur first scouts alone, finding frightened lower-ranked riders, widespread illness, rigid control, and contradictory readings for Brixaby's target card. When an eruption muster disrupts the search, Brixaby returns with the disguise cards and rescues him. Posing as the rare rider Ernest with a rare purple dragon, Arthur joins Purple Wing and meets Griff and Squish. Griff warns that riderless purples are fast, intelligent survivors despite their low status. At the eruption, Arthur sees Blood Moon's wing taking farm goods and animals rather than clearly prioritizing evacuation. He and Brixaby escape through their own portal and report back. New Houston is also deteriorating, with an attack on its wall and threats from a faction seeking political control. Despite that crisis, Arthur commits the full retinue to Blood Moon. Marion will investigate the sickness, Soledad will examine the nurseries and riderless purples, and the others will seek places inside the hive.

The disguised retinue enters Blood Moon Hive and separates into investigative roles. Brixaby's search produces changing numbers and locations for his missing cards, showing that the trail cannot be trusted. He also meets Candy Floss, a young riderless purple whose lightening power makes her useful for carrying large loads. She explains that common dragons surrender shards for food and that disfavored hatchlings are denied riders. Arthur finds displaced civilians whose property has been claimed as payment for evacuation and begins recruiting possible riders. Blood Moon's legendary leaders then summon him. They appoint him captain of Purple Wing and explain the blood price: every linked pair owes shards according to rank, default can be paid in life force, and a captain is responsible for the whole wing. Arthur accepts a binding oath and immediately incurs costs. After discovering a hidden term that permits remote siphoning, he secretly alters the oath to remove it. He and Brixaby then begin feeding the neglected purples and organizing the wing as a protected community rather than expendable labor.

Arthur develops Purple Wing into a functioning unit. Thackeray, a displaced merchant, links with Candy Floss, giving the pair unusual cargo potential. Steve links with a purple dragon whose rapid movement is powerful but inaccurate. Amanda links with a green hatchling, and their combined plant ability may support crop production. Larry fails to find a dragon partner, so Arthur hires him to gather intelligence and gives him a covert signal token. Griff reveals that Purple Wing's uncommons have been overcharged. Arthur makes Griff his second-in-command, takes direct control of payments, and forbids the wing from preying on other riders. Blood Moon's leadership continues to invent fees and publicly drains an indebted rare rider, producing rapid weakness and apparent aging. Marion's observations of prematurely aged commons strengthen the suspicion that the blood price systematically extracts life. With Arthur's reserves nearly exhausted and another eruption approaching, he proposes harvesting a recently sealed eruption cone instead of depending on fresh combat. He takes the active wing through Brixaby's portal, requires secrecy, and prepares to test whether purple speed can recover overlooked resources below the crater.

Purple Wing finds thousands of dead Scourgelings inside the frozen cone, but surviving creatures attack from below. After the defenders defeat them, a collapse separates Arthur from the wing and leaves him in a cavern of eggs tended by specialized Scourgelings. Brixaby reaches him, and together they discover a network of underground proto-nests. The tainted air can infect wounds with scourge rot, yet Arthur presses onward to locate the source. Deep below, he finds a heart-like core distributing shard essence to the nests. Arthur and Brixaby sever its connections and destroy it, leaving Arthur unconscious from the magical backlash. He wakes on the between-worlds river with unusual legendary origin shards recovered from the core. There he and Brixaby forge a legendary card that can accelerate or slow time at extreme mana cost, with a risk of mental and temporal disconnection if abused. Arthur takes the card because Brixaby cannot safely absorb another legendary card while still growing. They agree to conceal both the card and the deeper discovery from everyone outside the retinue.

After the crater expedition, Marion heals Arthur's physical injuries but finds lingering spiritual damage. Larry warns of a conspiracy to make the new purple captain pay the full blood price, apparently in more than shards, but an early eruption interrupts the investigation. Arthur organizes Purple Wing around rescue and accountable recovery. Thackeray manages valuable goods, Griff directs field operations, Steve trains under him, and Amanda joins hatchling support. At the eruption, coordinated Scourgeling waves overrun farms and forest. Purple Wing evacuates civilians while other wings focus on harvesting. Arthur and Brixaby rescue isolated survivors, then survive an ambush by two cloaked riderless dragons that may have acted opportunistically or may have been hired. As flyers and rare Scourgelings overwhelm the defenses, Arthur orders the exhausted noncombatants to withdraw with Griff. Cressida and Horatio leave safely with their trained wing, while Arthur and Brixaby remain near the collapsing front. The eruption has exceeded containment, farms remain in danger, and the defenders expect a legendary threat to emerge.

A legendary centipede-like demi-Scourgeling emerges, spreading poison and generating more creatures. Legendary dragons from several hives attack, but ordinary elemental assaults fail. Blood Moon's red legendary dragon uses life energy, causing the creature to grow uncontrollably and rupture into necrotic gas. Back at Blood Moon Hive, that dragon drains Desmond's injured blue dragon and Sybil's green dragon to restore itself and its rider. When the leader demands an advance on Arthur's blood price and attacks him, Arthur uses his concealed time card to evade the fire and removes the leader's cards. Brixaby then drops his disguise, revealing his legendary identity, and takes Call of Life from the former leader's dragon with help from Desmond's and Sybil's dragons. Arthur assumes command of Blood Moon and leaves Horatio and Sams in temporary charge as another eruption approaches. At the palace, Lung Bai recognizes Arthur's authority and identifies Asha as an origin of healing. Marion and Asha temporarily restore the king's awareness, but cannot cure his underlying condition. A stable king might regulate the eruptions, leaving the kingdom's immediate future uncertain.

characters.description: Brixaby's rider, a cardsmith, and the newly recognized leader of Blood Moon Hive. He begins his rule by examining a depleted card library and testing whether the former leader's staff will accept his authority.
characters.name: Arthur

characters.description: Arthur's unusually large legendary purple dragon and bonded field partner. His recent growth has made his old blacksmithing equipment unusable, while his portals and linked card powers remain central to Arthur's efforts to secure Blood Moon Hive.
characters.name: Brixaby

characters.description: The former leader's senior manservant and the keeper of a concealed card library. He appears unwilling to recognize Arthur's new authority, admits him to the nearly emptied library, and then seals the dimensional entrance behind him.
characters.name: Reginald

characters.description: One of Blood Moon Hive's two remaining legendary riders from the previous administration. Arthur regards him as a potential leader, but the old regime has left him passive and unprepared to exercise independent authority.
characters.name: Desmond

characters.description: A legendary Blood Moon rider and Desmond's associate. She is among the senior figures Arthur inherits when he takes control of the hive, although the former leader's command structure has given her little practice at governing on her own.
characters.name: Sybil

characters.description: Arthur's absent predecessor, whose exploitative rule depleted Blood Moon Hive's card reserves and left its people dependent on a rigid hierarchy.
characters.name: Former Blood Moon leader

characters.description: Equinox's rider. At her introduction, she is identified through her bond with the young red dragon as one of the rider-dragon teams available to Blood Moon Hive.
characters.name: Soledad

characters.description: A young red dragon bonded to Soledad. The pair belong to the developing group around Arthur and Blood Moon Hive, with Equinox still early in his growth and training when first identified as one of the hive's available rider-dragon teams.
characters.name: Equinox

characters.description: A hooded guide who operates in a void realm and can carry Arthur between planes. The guide helps Arthur leave the sealed library dimension and reach Wolf Moon Hive while pursuing Reginald.
characters.name: Hooded portal guide

characters.description: A power holder in Wolf Moon Hive and an active political enemy of Arthur. Reginald identifies his leadership circle as the source of a legendary-card bounty, making Whitaker a direct obstacle to Arthur's return and consolidation of Blood Moon Hive.
characters.name: Whitaker

characters.description: An emotion reader, Martine's rider, and a former associate of Arthur. After Whitaker marginalizes the pair and withholds their expected rewards, she negotiates practical living terms and agrees to relocate to Blood Moon Hive.
characters.name: Kenzie

characters.description: Kenzie's silver dragon, whose talents are oriented toward support rather than direct fighting. She can identify promising potential riders by scent and travels with Kenzie after their standing within Wolf Moon Hive deteriorates.
characters.name: Martine

characters.description: An elderly pink dragon and former chief tactics officer who volunteers for Arthur's retinue. She joins after the migration of Wolf Moon's neglected riderless dragons, bringing military experience to a force that urgently needs organization.
characters.name: Cinderwood

characters.description: Arthur's close ally and a shadow-moving combatant who helps convene his first major leadership meeting. She stands with him as he reports the emptied libraries and rejects continuation of Blood Moon Hive's blood price.
characters.name: Cressida

characters.description: The king's mythic dragon and a demanding patron of Arthur and Brixaby. Lung Bai treats legendary cards as tests of judgment, insists that they pursue advancement through their own choices, and requires Arthur to continue leading Blood Moon Hive.
characters.name: Lung Bai

characters.description: The ruler of the dragon hives, newly lucid enough to receive Arthur's report on the kingdom. His health still requires monitoring, and he asks for time to consider Arthur's account while Marion remains nearby to oversee his condition.
characters.name: The king

characters.description: A Blood Moon combatant who works in close partnership with Sams. During the hive's first disastrous eruption response, Arthur entrusts the pair with closing the portal used by mentally incapacitated riders.
characters.name: Horatio

characters.description: Horatio's dragon and a dependable partner in Blood Moon's portal response. Sams acts on Arthur's command to close the route through which disabled dragons and falling riders have been returning from the eruption.
characters.name: Sams

characters.description: A healer, Asha's rider, and the king's son. He returns after treating Lung Bai's dragon with a new energy-restoring card from the royal library, adding another capable healer to Arthur's circle after the eruption battle.
characters.name: Marion

characters.description: Marion's young silver healing dragon. She returns beside her rider after their work treating Lung Bai's dragon, forming a medical partnership whose skills are important to the exhausted fighters around Arthur.
characters.name: Asha

characters.description: Cressida's intuitive pink dragon and a traveler through shadows. While Brixaby lies exhausted after absorbing a legendary card, Joy receives a precise warning of approaching danger and helps the group escape before hostile scouts arrive.
characters.name: Joy

characters.description: Arthur's cousin, whose unexplained absence becomes alarming when Arthur investigates Rowantree Estate. Arthur's bond-seeking ability cannot locate Penn, adding to the evidence that the outwardly peaceful property is compromised.
characters.name: Penn

characters.description: One of Snow Moon Hive's leaders. He offers to place Arthur's forces in a legendary accelerated-time training space, with Arthur responsible for supplying the shards needed to operate it.
characters.name: Hale

characters.description: One of Snow Moon Hive's two leaders and a member of the gathered legendary leadership group. Rose joins the negotiations over accelerating eruptions and Blood Moon Hive's need for a stronger retinue.
characters.name: Rose

characters.description: The leader of Buck Moon Hive and holder of a legendary temporal ability. He evaluates Arthur by exploring several versions of their discussion, then accepts Arthur's opposition to the Scourgelings as credible.
characters.name: Ismael

characters.description: An escaped, body-hopping Scourge enemy connected to Arthur and Brixaby. The Mindsinger uses coercive song and mental control, making its continued freedom a threat even before its current location or next objective is known.
characters.name: Mindsinger

characters.description: A wild purple dragon with a natural storage card and a talent for logistics. He helps Arthur and Brixaby move their stockpiled training supplies into Blood Moon Hive, then receives a carrying harness and one of the new payment tokens.
characters.name: Studley

characters.description: Cinderwood's long-time unbonded human companion and a user of support cards. Dan Dan stabilizes Arthur after the crack-eruption battle, providing immediate aid when he emerges badly injured and depleted of life force.
characters.name: Dan Dan

characters.description: A former assistant to Whitaker and a possible informer with divided loyalties. She warns Arthur that enemies within the hives may be discussing his death during a Scourgeling battle, claiming friendship and self-preservation as her motives.
characters.name: Former Wolf Moon assistant

characters.description: Penn's father, Arthur's uncle, and the holder of the family card Master of Spells. In the Rowantree winery he declares loyalty to the Mindsinger and traps Arthur with a runic array that cuts him off from his cards.
characters.name: Lionel Rowantree

recaps.ending: Arthur leaves Rowantree Estate holding Master of Spells, the fourth card in his Master set. Brixaby has incapacitated Lionel, but Lionel's degree of control and his eventual fate remain unsettled, and the Mindsinger is still free. Penn is alive and rid of the known lethal cards and visible control runes, though he remains emotionally vulnerable and intends to reclaim the estate after his father is helped or contained. Cressida has recovered from her blood curse. Marion is exhausted after repairing Penn's heart deck, while Arthur and Brixaby continue to bear the risks of temporal damage and life-force magic. Desmond and Sybil are expelled from Blood Moon Hive after challenging Arthur's authority. The reformed hive retains its currency, rescue wing, and strengthened training force, but its internal stability is not assured. The discovery of hidden egg clusters becomes an immediate kingdom-wide crisis when simultaneous eruptions begin. Arthur and Brixaby portal to the king's palace for an emergency meeting, still short of the cards needed for their hoped-for mythic advancement.
recaps.in_short: Arthur takes control of a depleted Blood Moon Hive and begins replacing its coercive hierarchy with organized rescue forces and a tracked currency. Repeated eruptions expose both the danger of his new cards and a wider Scourge plan. Accelerated training strengthens his allies, but an investigation of Rowantree Estate reveals the Mindsinger's control, Penn's trapped heart deck, and hidden hatcheries beneath settlements across the kingdom. Arthur and Brixaby destroy a major crack eruption, then Marion and Joy help free Penn from lethal cards and runic commands. Lionel Rowantree serves the Mindsinger and loses Master of Spells to Arthur, while Brixaby incapacitates him. Arthur expels Desmond and Sybil after their armed challenge. He finishes with four Master-set cards as simultaneous eruptions force him and Brixaby to answer an emergency summons from the king.

recaps.text: Previously: Arthur and his dragon Brixaby became linked to an unfinished path toward mythic power, with Arthur building a set of Master cards and Brixaby gathering complementary abilities. Their advancement carries a debt to Lung Bai and the other mythics, who expect them to meet the required tests themselves. Arthur also encountered the Mindsinger, a body-hopping Scourge enemy capable of controlling minds, but the enemy escaped. Arthur and Brixaby enter this volume still pursuing advancement while the Mindsinger remains at large.

Arthur begins his rule of Blood Moon Hive by inspecting its secret card library, only to find it stripped of valuable cards. Reginald, the former leader's senior manservant, traps him inside and flees to Wolf Moon Hive. Arthur escapes through Brixaby's portal network, pursues Reginald, removes the cards enabling his flight, and expels him from Blood Moon. Reginald confirms that Wolf Moon's leadership has offered a legendary-card bounty for Arthur. Arthur then recruits Kenzie and her silver dragon Martine, who have been marginalized under Whitaker's rule. Wolf Moon has also neglected a large colony of riderless dragons. Arthur and Brixaby offer those dragons food, possible riders, and a place in the war against the Scourgelings. When Wolf Moon riders intervene, Brixaby uses his alarming life-draining power to force Arthur's release. More than a hundred dragons follow them back to Blood Moon. Cinderwood, an elderly former tactics officer, volunteers for Arthur's retinue, leaving him with both a valuable new force and an urgent organizational problem.

Arthur rejects Blood Moon's blood-price system but discovers that the hive has lost the habit of acting without direct orders. Its first eruption response collapses when a mental attack incapacitates deployed dragons and riders. Arthur and Brixaby warn other hives, then return with legendary leaders to an eruption covered in concealed flying Scourgelings. Whitaker attempts to seize Arthur, but the other leaders stop the confrontation. Arthur and Brixaby drop a lit furnace from high altitude, collapsing much of the eruption cone and leaving the Demi Scourgeling apparently dead. Lung Bai and the king arrive to contain the remaining threat. Lung Bai expects Arthur to use Cataclysmic Firestorm. The card produces multiplying flames that consume the swarm and sterilize the battlefield, but its hunger begins to overwhelm Arthur until Brixaby breaks the connection. Arthur recalls the fire only after the infestation is destroyed. The victory establishes Arthur publicly as Blood Moon's leader, yet the card is too psychologically dangerous to wield casually. Beneath the collapsed eruption site, Brixaby senses the creature's legendary card, giving the pair a reason to return in secret.

Arthur returns to the eruption site with a small team. The Demi Scourgeling is still alive, but Horatio and Sams finish it, allowing Arthur to recover the legendary Choice of Venom. Brixaby immediately absorbs the card and collapses while assimilating its powers. Arthur attempts to harvest the eruption heart alone. Its mind magic identifies him as Arthur Rowantree, shows him Rowantree Estate, and drains him until he escapes with Return to Start. After Brixaby survives the assimilation, Arthur investigates the estate with Cressida and Joy. Penn, Arthur's cousin, cannot be located, and singing workers exert mental control over the visitors. Arthur recognizes the influence as the escaped Mindsinger's work. Rather than expose a large force to possession, he seeks help from other legendary leaders. They report that eruptions are accelerating and urge him to build a stronger retinue. Arthur secures access to a time-accelerated training space in exchange for shards and an oath restricting Brixaby's card-taking. Seers predict two eruptions within forty-eight hours, placing a firm deadline on the preparation.

Arthur sends more than two hundred riders, dragons, prospective bonders, and support personnel into an accelerated training space under Soledad, Marion, and Cinderwood. He and Brixaby enter a separate pocket where two months will pass in roughly ten outside hours. Arthur develops his cardsmithing, learning to guide card creation and to alter compatible cards through carefully chosen shards. He makes new construction, light-combat, and art-combat cards, adds an optional trigger to Return to Start, and modifies a healing card to address temporal harm. He refuses to alter his damaged legendary time card directly because a failure could destroy both travelers and the pocket. Brixaby improves flight, enchantment, stone identification, and dropped-projectile techniques. He also creates quartz protections against several forms of mental influence and discovers a forceful aerial maneuver with potential for Purple Wing. Together they develop a riding harness, stockpile javelins and rocks, and revise Arthur's telekinetic projectile card so it can launch wooden weapons. They leave the pocket with better skills, anti-control tools, and supplies for both the predicted eruptions and the confrontation at Rowantree Estate.

Arthur and Brixaby return to Blood Moon and begin replacing the blood price with enchanted garnets that function as traceable currency. When wing captains admit that Desmond encouraged them to continue the old collections, Arthur formally abolishes the practice and orders restitution. As the first predicted eruption begins, he forces Desmond and Sybil into active duty, then takes Brixaby, Cressida, and Joy to Rowantree Estate. Illusions hide armed workers, traps, and diseased dragons under mental control. Arthur is captured and made to fight Penn, but recognizes an outside fear effect and spares him. Brixaby exposes runes concealed across Penn's body, and Arthur washes them away. Penn reveals that the Mindsinger removed his cards, including Master of Combat, and filled his heart deck with lethal traps. Arthur offers him sanctuary and stores him in a timeless personal space. During the retreat, Cressida suffers a near-fatal blood curse. The accelerated training group returns early, with Marion and Asha greatly strengthened, and they remove the remaining curse fragments. Cressida wakes, but Penn's trapped heart deck and the occupied estate remain unresolved as the second predicted eruption begins.

Cressida must remain on bed rest, so she lends Arthur her Bubble Shield before the second eruption. A deep fissure opens near a city, and Sams identifies it as a crack eruption with a legendary Demi Scourgeling below. With Desmond and Sybil absent, Arthur mobilizes Purple Wing, Cinderwood's dragons, and available cardholders. Purple dragons rescue civilians while earth, water, root, fire, ice, and light users contain the fissure. Arthur and Brixaby dive through the mass of Scourgelings to the eruption heart. Arthur uses the borrowed shield to overcome a repelling force, allowing Brixaby to poison the creature and take its card before it fully hatches. They destroy the heart, but the collapse traps them. Brixaby drains nearby Scourgelings and transfers life energy to Arthur, who burns it to sustain the shield before collapsing. Brixaby carries him out in a personal space. Dan Dan, Cinderwood's long-time companion, stabilizes Arthur, and both rescuers receive legendary shards. The remaining infestation becomes a cleanup operation, and Brixaby emerges with the legendary utility card Ultimate Earthcrafter.

Arthur trades Ultimate Earthcrafter and three legendary shards to Lung Bai for five healing cards. He reshapes them into a coordinated heart-deck repair set, worsening his own temporal injury in the process. Marion accepts the set, which merges into What Is Broken Is Not Lost. When Penn is released, a compulsive song drives him to attack, and his trapped cards create pain and an expanding risk of catastrophe. With Penn's consent, Marion repairs the damage left by the removal of Master of Combat. Joy then uses nullifying claws to erase the self-restoring runes that continue to command him. Penn explains that the Mindsinger conquered Rowantree Estate after debt drove it into covert card sales. His father holds Master of Spells, a family legendary card connected to Arthur's set. A former Wolf Moon assistant also warns Arthur of a possible plot involving Whitaker, Desmond, and Sybil. Using Call of the Heart, Arthur discovers concealed Scourgeling egg clusters under settlements across the kingdom. Penn permits removal of his remaining lethal cards and agrees to help Arthur recover Master of Spells. Their immediate target is the winery above Rowantree Estate's hidden hatchery.

Arthur deploys Blood Moon Hive to Rowantree Estate with protections against mental control, orders Purple Wing to rescue civilians, and forbids looting. While Brixaby and the retinue fight Scourgelings and hostile dragons outside, Arthur enters the winery alone. Lionel Rowantree, Penn's father and Arthur's uncle, declares loyalty to the Mindsinger and confirms that stronger Scourge forces stand behind the hatchery network. Lionel traps Arthur in a runic array that blocks access to his cards and drops him among Scourgelings. Arthur disrupts the runes with raw mana until Brixaby breaks in and nullifies the trap. Lionel surrenders Master of Spells, then Brixaby incapacitates him and transfers some of his life energy to Arthur. Arthur installs the card as the fourth member of his Master set. Desmond and Sybil arrive under temporary spell enhancements and challenge his authority. Arthur copies Sybil's spell, forces a standoff, and expels them from Blood Moon Hive. The Mindsinger remains free, Lionel's lasting condition is uncertain, and Penn is alive but fragile. As seers detect simultaneous eruptions across the kingdom, Arthur and Brixaby portal to the king's palace for an emergency meeting.

characters.description: A twelve-year-old borderland boy who resents Baron Kane and is fascinated by card magic. After witnessing a riderless dragon destroy the baron's carriage guard, he is ordered to open the locked case found in the wreck.
characters.name: Arthur

characters.description: Arthur's father and the adult he trusts most. Calvan lives as a laborer in Border Village No. 49 and is Arthur's intended confidant after the dragon attack.
characters.name: Calvan

characters.description: The noble who rules Arthur's borderland home. His guarded carriage carries a valuable card until a dragon attacks it.
characters.name: Baron Kane

characters.description: An unnamed, riderless red dragon that ambushes Baron Kane's carriage, kills its carded escort, and takes their cards. It finds a locked case in the wreck and orders Arthur to open it.
characters.name: the red dragon

characters.description: Arthur's closest friend in the border village. Arthur thinks of him while deciding where to hide the stolen card, but fears that even his best friend would be unable to keep such a dangerous secret.
characters.name: Ernie

characters.description: A village kitchen worker whose feet have been amputated. Yuma directs Arthur while he prepares food for the dragon-soil work crews, giving him the practical experience through which his strange new card begins producing visible skills.
characters.name: Yuma

characters.description: Baron Kane's carded treasure seeker. Dino uses a long-range ability to locate Calvan's hidden cache of knives and coins in the woods, but does not find the card Arthur carries.
characters.name: Dino

characters.description: Ernie's mother. Amanda becomes gravely ill after eating scourge-tainted food and dies despite Arthur's attempt to help prepare medicine; Ernie dies from the same illness soon afterward.
characters.name: Amanda

characters.description: A well-provisioned traveler associated with Calvan who arrives with the donkey Bella. Red quietly tests Arthur's honesty and considers him for an opportunity that may provide a route away from the increasingly dangerous border village.
characters.name: Red

characters.description: Red's donkey and Arthur's early animal-care companion. Looking after her briefly eases his grief and helps him develop equine care skills.
characters.name: Bella

characters.description: The identity Arthur uses while traveling with Red's caravan, chosen to keep attention away from his family background. The young apprentice presents himself under this name while learning caravan work and concealing the true nature of his card.
characters.name: Ernest Youngblood

characters.description: Red's physically imposing second-in-command and the owner of a cart covered with tobacco. He strikes Arthur for looking beneath the guarded cart.
characters.name: Second

characters.description: One of Second's associates in the caravan. Hivey joins in belittling Arthur and helps enforce Second's intimidating presence around the guarded tobacco cart, whose concealed contents Arthur is determined to discover.
characters.name: Hivey

characters.description: A Harvest Moon dragon rider partnered with Doshi. Chancy investigates vandalism at a schoolhouse by combining his far-seeing ability with Doshi's magic, reconstructing the offense and offering a carded boy hive work in place of punishment.
characters.name: Chancy

characters.description: Chancy's silver-blue dragon partner. Doshi helps investigate a local crime through a combined magical reconstruction, detects unusual power around Arthur, and privately approaches him through a projected image while he is away from the caravan.
characters.name: Doshi

characters.description: Bert referees the boys' gambling match and has a card. Chancy gives him the option of working for the hive rather than receiving a beating and paying restitution.
characters.name: Bert

characters.description: A small purple dragon serving on a hive rescue team. Tess and her rider save Arthur from pursuing scourgelings after his escape from Second, then carry him through a spatial rift toward a hive rather than returning him to the caravan.
characters.name: Tess

characters.description: Tess's rider and a member of a capable hive rescue pair. Hive staff identify Johanna while explaining that she and Tess are among their strongest rescuers.
characters.name: Johanna

characters.description: A hive official responsible for receiving survivors. Magda records Arthur as an uncarded displaced farm boy under the history he supplies, arranges medical attention, and explains how rescue teams and care for young evacuees operate.
characters.name: Magda

characters.description: The head director of the Wolf Cub Orphanage. Freyja places Arthur with Horatio, lays out the institution's rules, and uses a card-mark test to evaluate whether Arthur is ready to accept a card, unaware that he is already concealing cards.
characters.name: Freyja

characters.description: Arthur's new roommate at the Wolf Cub Orphanage. Horatio has a reputation for poor work, greets Arthur with hostility, and resents being assigned to help him settle in.
characters.name: Horatio

characters.description: A young silver dragon whose ability to smell strong magic makes Arthur's hidden cards dangerous to carry near the hive. Marteen searches the arena crowd for the source of two exceptional card scents despite her rider's attempts to control her.
characters.name: Marteen

characters.description: A rare yellow dragon with a light aspect who once belonged to Horatio's father. Sams remains unlinked after that rider's death and waits for Horatio to obtain a rare card compatible with his light-enhancing abilities.
characters.name: Sams

characters.description: The restaurant's head chef, who recognizes Arthur's cooking ability and hires him as a part-time apprentice while he remains in school.
characters.name: the restaurant head chef

characters.description: The restaurant's head chef, now identified as Chef Barlow. He supports Arthur's kitchen work and indicates that a bakery position may open for Horatio.
characters.name: Chef Barlow

characters.description: Marteen's rider and the person responsible for Arthur after the silver dragon carries him to the hive. Kenzie apologizes for the abduction and explains the dragon's intense interest in him.
characters.name: Kenzie

characters.description: A hostile dragon rider who corners Arthur in restricted hive tunnels and demands a toll. Deacon uses a force effect to pin him against a wall and tries to seize his anchor bag until Kenzie intervenes and threatens a duel.
characters.name: Deacon

characters.description: A riderless purple dragon whose former partner, Deborah, was killed. Pregnant and expecting her ordinary clutch to be disregarded, Corrie avoids the assigned nesting area and hides in a cave to lay an unusually small egg.
characters.name: Corrie

characters.description: Calvan's successor and Arthur's uncle, encountered at Wolfmoon as a noble seeking access to a rare hatchling. Arthur confirms the family connection from a crest preserved among his mother's possessions.
characters.name: Lionel Rowantree

characters.description: Lionel Rowantree's son and Arthur's cousin. Arthur identifies Penn from their family connection while covertly following his newly discovered relatives at Wolfmoon.
characters.name: Pennrow Rowantree

characters.description: The false noble identity Arthur adopts when Penn catches him near Lionel's guest apartment. Presenting himself as Baron Kane's son lets Arthur remain close to his Rowantree relatives while concealing both his true family connection and his investigation.
characters.name: Ernest Kane

characters.description: A border-village specialist whom Calvan asks to examine Lionel's stolen card box. Lena analyzes its rune protections and works with Arthur to breach the outer lock.
characters.name: Lena

recaps.ending: Arthur returns from the stolen card shipment to Calvan, discovers that the haul contains Master of Body Enhancement, and uses the remaining cards to give borderland children a way out. Calvan cannot accept a card or leave because of his royal oath, so Arthur departs with twelve children held safely in Personal Space and leaves Calvan cards to distribute. Back at Wolfmoon, Lionel and Penn fail to locate the concealed shipment and leave after the scandal. Arthur adds Master of Body Enhancement beside Master of Skills, opening new paths of advancement. Horatio receives Ultraviolet Light Manipulation and leaves with Sams to pursue their link. Kenzie knows about the hidden children and remains allied with Arthur. The immediate new danger is a tiny black legendary egg found beside a dead purple dragon. Its magic may have killed the dragon, and its connection to Corrie's earlier egg is not established.
recaps.in_short: Arthur, a borderland boy, hides the Legendary Master of Skills after a dragon steals it from Baron Kane. His father Calvan sends him away with a caravan, where Arthur develops unusual practical skills, survives a scourge eruption, takes the rare Return to Start card, and escapes a murderous Second. At Wolfmoon, he conceals his power while becoming a cook, scholar, thief, and recruit of Kenzie and Marteen. He befriends Horatio and helps him seek a card compatible with Sams. Years later, Arthur learns that his uncle Lionel Rowantree is selling their family card library. Arthur, Horatio, and Sams steal the shipment. Arthur returns to Calvan, finds the Legendary Master of Body Enhancement inside, and evacuates twelve border children through Personal Space. Lionel's seekers fail to detect the hidden cards. Horatio leaves with Sams and a compatible rare card, while Arthur adds the second legendary card and joins Kenzie in discovering a dangerous black legendary egg beside a dead dragon.

recaps.text: Arthur witnesses a riderless red dragon destroy Baron Kane's guarded carriage and take the dead guards' cards. The dragon leaves him with the locked spell card from the cargo and threatens his family if Kane recovers it or learns the truth. Arthur places the card in his own heart deck, activating the Legendary Master of Skills. It turns experience into visible abilities, allowing him to improve quickly at cooking, literacy, repairs, and other practical work. Kane's men search the village and punish its people, but overlook Arthur because he is young. Arthur eventually confesses to Calvan. His father reveals knowledge of card magic and later explains that he was once a duke whose lands and cards were taken, leaving him bound by a borderland oath. When Arthur's friend Ernie and Ernie's mother die after eating scourge-tainted food, Arthur resolves to become capable enough to save others. Calvan arranges for the caravan trader Red to test Arthur as a prospective apprentice, offering the boy a secret route out of the village.

Arthur leaves with Red under the name Ernest Youngblood, while Calvan plans to disguise his absence through false village records. Red opposes dependence on cards, but his second-in-command does not share his restraint. Second guards a tobacco-covered cart, mistreats Arthur for showing interest in it, and later claims a favor after saving him from attackers. Arthur develops stealth, gambling, knot-tying, and lockpicking skills, then discovers that the cart hides a complete common earth-card set. He refuses to steal it. In a nearby town, the rider Chancy and the silver-blue dragon Doshi investigate vandalism through complementary powers. Doshi privately detects Arthur's legendary card, explains that silver dragons can perceive concealed cards, and agrees to keep his secret. Arthur continues earning money and combines gambling abilities into his first skill-based class. As the caravan travels onward, animal warnings reveal that a scourge eruption is opening nearby, forcing the entire company to flee.

Dragons arrive to fight the spreading scourgelings, while Second uses Arthur's debt to pull him into a scavenging expedition with Hivey. Second intends to collect shards and loot fallen riders or dragons. Arthur treats Hivey's injuries after an attack, but Second keeps nearly all recovered material and abandons an offered common card when richer prey appears. Sent to search alone, Arthur evades other scavengers and reaches a dead rider. He secretly takes one card and hands Second another. Second detects the deception and attacks him with the newly acquired card's plant power. Arthur has no clear route back to the caravan or Calvan.

Return to Start removes Arthur from Second's attack, depositing him at the site the caravan previously occupied. Pursuing scourgelings nearly catch him before Tess and her rider intervene. The rescuers cross a spatial rift with Arthur and deliver him to a hive. There, Magda accepts Arthur's false account of being an uncarded farm survivor and places him in the Wolf Cub Orphanage. Freyja assigns Horatio as his roommate and unknowingly confirms that Arthur appears ready for a first card. Arthur chooses kitchen work as his cover, proves his ability, and advances rapidly through school and restaurant training. Horatio is abrasive but deeply knowledgeable about card combinations, dragon links, and the dangers faced by riders with common cards. During an illegal trip to the Wolf Arena, he shows Arthur how coordinated cards can outperform a larger collection and explains that an anchor mark can carry cards outside the heart. The young silver dragon Marteen scents two exceptional cards in the crowd, forcing Arthur and Horatio to retreat. Horatio realizes Arthur is hiding a high-ranked card and agrees to remain silent if Arthur helps him obtain a rare card. He then reveals that Sams, his late father's yellow dragon, is waiting for him to gain a compatible light-based card.

Arthur buys an anchor bag for Return to Start and assembles stealth, deception, lockpicking, and related abilities into a Thief class. Marteen finds him anyway and carries him to her rider, Kenzie. Kenzie treats him as a possible recruit and arranges hive access for both Arthur and Horatio, believing Marteen senses merely unusual magic rather than a legendary card. Arthur steals a common card from the hive commissary, recovers it during the investigation, and escapes through Return to Start when stopped. Chef Barlow discreetly buys the card for shards and access to a recipe book. Arthur excels academically, graduates early, and takes charge of the orphanage breakfast kitchen, although his desired Cooking class remains elusive. On a later hive visit, the dragon rider Deacon attempts to extort Arthur and seize his anchor bag. Kenzie drives him away, trains Arthur to resist physical holds and emotional pressure, trades the boys' shards upward, and offers Arthur access to hatchlings if he commits to the hive.

Kenzie shows Arthur that his legendary card prevents ordinary hatchlings from taking interest in him, though she still does not know its rank. A second kitchen job supplies the missing breadth of experience, and Arthur unlocks a more advanced Cooking class after improvising a new dish. Elsewhere, the riderless purple dragon Corrie hides in a cave, lays a strange light-absorbing egg, and dies. Four years pass. Arthur creates the rare Personal Space card, a large hidden store in which living creatures do not experience time, and gains a common card that lets him temporarily disable cards in his heart. Horatio completes the rare Second Helpings card, only to learn that it is incompatible with Sams. During festivities around another rare egg, Arthur recognizes Duke Lionel Rowantree as his uncle and Penn as his cousin. He searches Lionel's rooms, discovers plans to sell cards from the family library, and adopts the identity Ernest Kane when Penn encounters him.

Arthur continues posing as Ernest Kane while gathering details of Lionel's discreet card auction. Horatio chooses to keep Second Helpings despite its incompatibility with Sams, but the three agree to steal Lionel's shipment in hopes of finding a better card. Arthur proves that Personal Space can safely hold a willing person, making it central to the plan. Kenzie helps create a legitimate leave and courier trail in exchange for Arthur's shards. When the guarded cart approaches Wolfmoon, Sams blinds its escort with reflected sunlight while a disguised Horatio poses as his rider. Arthur enters the cart, is seized and choked by a card-enhanced guard, and defeats him by drawing and using a binding card from the guard's anchor. He stores the entire shipment, reactivates Return to Start, and is transported to the distant borderland cabin. Calvan, who had believed him dead since the eruption, recognizes his returned son.

Arthur tells Calvan how he survived and supplies the starving village with stored food, livestock, and plantable produce. Calvan explains that royal oaths bind most adult residents, though children can still be removed. Arthur admits stealing Lionel's shipment. Lena helps breach its rune lock, and Arthur's Rowantree blood opens the inner seal. The prize is Legendary Master of Body Enhancement, a companion to Master of Skills. Calvan refuses it because his oath forbids him from taking cards. Instead, Arthur offers cards and escape to village children. With parental consent, he places twelve children in the timeless safety of Personal Space, five carrying new cards, and leaves much of the remaining shipment with Calvan for other young people. Tess and Johanna return Arthur to Wolfmoon. Horatio and Sams escaped the robbery safely, and Arthur gives Horatio the rare Ultraviolet Light Manipulation card. They leave together for Horatio's former hive while Arthur tests whether Lionel's seekers can see through Personal Space.

Four weeks later, Lionel and Penn have left Wolfmoon after the theft scandal. Their private seekers failed to detect the cards hidden inside Arthur's Personal Space, confirming that he can protect both the shipment and the twelve evacuated children while arranging their gradual placement in orphanages. Calvan remains in the border village, still bound by his royal oath, but now holds cards to distribute and a rare card reserved for a future attempt to break that bond. Arthur safely adds Master of Body Enhancement to his heart beside Master of Skills. The paired legendary cards expose his base attributes, unlock classes that depend on both bodily and utility abilities, and accelerate his first new physical skills. Horatio has departed with Sams and a compatible rare light card, while Kenzie and Marteen remain Arthur's recruiter allies. Arthur and Kenzie then enter a cave and find a dead purple dragon beside a tiny black egg. Kenzie identifies the egg as dangerous and legendary, and believes its magic may have killed the dragon. Its origin remains uncertain.

characters.description: The intelligent computer left at Landing by Pern's original colonists and recently awakened after thousands of years. AIVAS holds scientific records, teaching programs, and a detailed understanding of Thread, and presents itself as an adviser whose purpose is to help Pern complete the work for which it was built.
characters.name: AIVAS

characters.description: The Lord Holder of Ruatha and rider of the unique white dragon Ruth. Jaxom has grown from an unconventional boy into a leader trusted by both Hold and Weyr, and his curiosity about ancient Landing makes him one of AIVAS's most committed students.
characters.name: Jaxom

characters.description: Jaxom's small white dragon, intelligent, confident, and unusually exact about where and when he is. Ruth's command of between and his rapport with fire-lizards give him abilities that may matter as much as the strength of a larger dragon.
characters.name: Ruth

characters.description: Benden Weyrleader and rider of bronze Mnementh. F'lar united the Weyrs against the returning Thread and has spent decades pressing Pern's traditional institutions to cooperate and change. AIVAS now offers the permanent victory he has always wanted.
characters.name: F'lar

characters.description: Benden Weyrwoman and rider of the senior queen Ramoth. Lessa's daring journey into the past saved Pern at the beginning of the Pass; she remains a formidable political leader who weighs AIVAS's promises against her duty to dragons and riders.
characters.name: Lessa

characters.description: Pern's Masterharper and its most widely trusted diplomat. Robinton has long used music, education, and personal persuasion to bridge the divisions among Weyr, Hold, and Craft, and he greets AIVAS's recovered knowledge with delighted curiosity.
characters.name: Robinton

characters.description: A harper, explorer, and former apprentice of Robinton who helped uncover Landing's secrets. Piemur is resourceful, irreverent toward rank, and well suited to practical work that crosses the boundaries between crafts.
characters.name: Piemur

characters.description: A skilled Smithcraft journeywoman and Master Fandarel's granddaughter. Jancis combines technical discipline with the flexibility to learn from AIVAS, and she works closely with Piemur on converting ancient instruction into tools Pern can actually build.
characters.name: Jancis

characters.description: The head of the Smithcraft, renowned for patient reasoning and large-scale engineering. Fandarel sees AIVAS as a teacher capable of advancing Pernese craft, while insisting that plans be translated into sound materials and repeatable work.
characters.name: Fandarel

characters.description: A gifted harper and composer whose fire-lizards helped reveal the intelligence of Pern's small dragons. Menolly is close to Robinton and contributes both musical insight and practical loyalty to the circle working at Landing.
characters.name: Menolly

characters.description: A senior harper and Menolly's partner, trained by Robinton in the Hall's diplomatic as well as musical work. Sebell helps maintain communication and trust while AIVAS's lessons create excitement and resistance across Pern.
characters.name: Sebell

characters.description: Jaxom's wife, a healer from the Southern Continent and Lady Holder of Ruatha. Sharra understands both Jaxom's physical limits and his need to take part in work that joins his responsibilities as rider and Holder.
characters.name: Sharra

characters.description: Jaxom's former guardian and a onetime dragonrider who became Ruatha's steward after losing his dragon. Lytol brings personal knowledge of both Weyr and Hold to Landing and treats the colonists' recovered history with grave attention.
characters.name: Lytol

characters.description: A retired Weyrleader who came from the past with the Oldtimer dragonriders but chose cooperation over their later isolation. D'ram offers experience, patience, and a perspective spanning very different periods of Weyr custom.
characters.name: D'ram

characters.description: A bronze rider entrusted with leading one of Pern's newer Weyrs. T'gellan belongs to the generation prepared to work across old regional divisions and to test the unfamiliar methods AIVAS proposes.
characters.name: T'gellan

characters.description: The conservative head of the Glasscraft. Norist distrusts AIVAS and fears that sudden dependence on ancient machines will overturn the authority, skills, and social order the Crafts have preserved.
characters.name: Norist

recaps.ending: After years of preparation compressed into months of training and dangerous transport, the dragonriders carry the colony ships' great engines to their calculated positions on the Red Star. The coordinated operation succeeds: the detonations alter its orbit enough to prevent the future close approaches that bring Thread to Pern. The current generation still has responsibilities during the remaining fall, but future Passes will no longer recur. Opponents of AIVAS attack the project and abduct Robinton, but he is recovered and the plan survives their interference. Once the orbital change is confirmed, AIVAS declares its original purpose fulfilled and shuts itself down, leaving its students with extensive recovered knowledge and the responsibility to choose how Pern will use it. Robinton, already weakened by age and the strain of the crisis, dies soon afterward. His death joins the triumph with a profound personal loss for Menolly, Sebell, Lessa, F'lar, Jaxom, and their allies. Pern ends the story with Thread's ultimate defeat secured, but without the two guiding voices that made the victory possible.
recaps.in_short: After Jaxom, Piemur, and their companions awaken AIVAS at ancient Landing, the computer reveals a plan to end Thread permanently by changing the Red Star's orbit. AIVAS teaches science to selected riders, Smiths, and Harpers, restores access to the original colony ships, and trains dragons to travel between to positions in space. Jaxom and Ruth, F'lar, Lessa, and leaders from all the Weyrs coordinate the dangerous operation while conservative Craft leaders resist the social changes surrounding the new knowledge. The dragonriders ultimately move and deploy the ships' engines on the Red Star; their detonation shifts its path so future close passes will not bring Thread to Pern. Anti-AIVAS conspirators abduct Robinton but fail to stop the mission. With its task complete, AIVAS shuts itself down. Robinton dies soon afterward, leaving his friends to grieve even as Pern celebrates freedom from the ancient cycle. The survivors inherit both a safer world and the recovered knowledge needed to reshape it.

recaps.text: During Dragonflight, Lessa of Ruatha Impressed the queen Ramoth and became Benden Weyrwoman beside Weyrleader F'lar. When Thread returned to an unprepared Pern, Lessa traveled four centuries into the past and brought the missing Weyrs forward to defend the planet. Dragonquest followed the political conflict between those Oldtimer riders and Benden's reformers; it also saw young Lord Jaxom of Ruatha secretly Impress the undersized white dragon Ruth. In The White Dragon, Jaxom and Ruth earned acceptance as a fighting pair, explored the Southern Continent, and helped connect the Weyrs, Holds, and Crafts to evidence of Pern's lost colonial past. Later exploration at the ancient settlement called Landing uncovered intact machinery. Jaxom, Piemur, Jancis, and their companions activated AIVAS, an artificial intelligence left by the first colonists. AIVAS knows why Thread falls, has records of the technology Pern lost, and claims it can devise a way to end the threat rather than merely surviving each Pass.

AIVAS begins teaching a selected group at Landing, adapting lessons in mathematics, physics, engineering, and history to people raised without advanced machines. Jaxom and Ruth, Piemur and Jancis, Master Fandarel, Robinton, and the Benden leaders become the bridge between the computer and Pern's institutions. AIVAS explains that Thread's cycle is tied to the wandering Red Star and proposes attacking the cause by changing that world's orbit. The plan depends on machinery left in the original colony ships and on dragons learning to travel where no rider has previously asked them to go. F'lar supports the chance to free every future generation, despite the scale of the risk.

Training expands beyond a small circle. Smiths recover dormant systems and manufacture precise new equipment, Harpers organize records and instruction, and dragonriders practice unfamiliar visualizations under AIVAS's direction. The computer's history of the colony overturns beliefs that had become tradition after thousands of years. Many people welcome useful knowledge, but others fear that AIVAS is setting the Crafts aside or making leaders dependent on a machine no living person fully understands. Master Norist becomes a prominent voice of suspicion. Robinton and the other intermediaries try to keep debate open while the technical teams prove that AIVAS's instructions can produce practical results.

Dragons demonstrate that between can take them beyond Pern's atmosphere when riders are given reliable coordinates and images. AIVAS directs missions to the old colony ships, where equipment has waited in orbit since the first settlement. Jaxom and Ruth are especially valuable because Ruth always knows his position in time and space, while experienced Weyrleaders organize the many pairs needed for transport. The recovered systems confirm that the Red Star can be altered, but the engines and supplies involved are enormous. Every stage must be divided into loads dragons can carry, rehearsed across the Weyrs, and completed without losing riders to vacuum, bad coordinates, or fatigue.

AIVAS turns the orbital proposal into a sequence of coordinated operations. Smithcraft teams prepare fittings and controls, while riders learn to arrive at exact locations rather than relying only on familiar landscapes. F'lar must persuade all the Weyrs that the computer's calculations justify risking scarce dragons on a mission whose reward lies largely in Pern's future. Opposition also hardens among people who regard the project as an assault on custom and human authority. Robinton uses the trust he has built over a lifetime to defend learning without demanding blind obedience, and AIVAS continues supplying evidence, but neither argument removes the fear created by rapid change.

The Weyrs commit to AIVAS's plan and begin the most demanding transport stages. Teams move components from the colony ships, place guidance equipment, and practice the timed jumps required to reach the Red Star. Jaxom and Ruth help connect technical specialists with riders, while Lessa, F'lar, and the other Weyrleaders distribute risk across the fighting force so ordinary Thread defense can continue. Successful trials show that dragons can operate in space with proper preparation. The project is now physically possible, but its final maneuvers leave almost no margin for error, and organized opponents are increasingly willing to disrupt Landing rather than wait for debate to change the leaders' minds.

The final operation approaches as dragon and human teams assemble the engines and controls AIVAS requires. Each Weyr has a defined part in a schedule calculated around the Red Star's motion. The riders must trust coordinates they cannot verify by sight and carry loads in conditions their species never evolved to face. At Landing, security concerns grow alongside the technical pressure, because opponents of AIVAS now threaten people as well as equipment. Robinton remains one of the computer's strongest public defenders, while his friends try to shield both him and the mission from the costs of that position. The plan to alter the Red Star is ready, but its success and the fate of its chief advocates remain unresolved.

The dragonriders execute AIVAS's schedule, transporting and activating the old colony ships' engines at the calculated points on the Red Star. The detonations change its orbit enough to prevent the future close passages that have brought Thread to Pern for millennia. Opposition culminates in violence and Robinton's abduction, but he is rescued and the conspirators fail to stop the project. After instruments confirm success, AIVAS announces that its colonial assignment is complete and deliberately shuts itself down, leaving its students the knowledge it has restored. Robinton, worn down by age and the ordeal, dies soon afterward. His friends lose the human mediator who helped all Pern work together just as they lose the ancient intelligence that designed the victory. F'lar, Lessa, Jaxom, the Crafts, and all the Weyrs must now carry that work forward themselves, with the promise that once the remaining Thread has passed, it will never return.
